findings.where: episodes/ep03.md:99 and :158-159 (key_image=場面 ep03 for s14b) vs _shared/採用表.md:72 (row 27)
findings.what: s14b reuses the existing ep03 scene board, and the design claims it shows「半ば閉じた台帳・折れた縁が立つ」。
findings.why: 採用表 describes the ep03 board as「白頁とペン先の跡。折れ目は讀めない」— the standing fold is NOT in the board, and the board still carries the pen-tip mark on the white first page that the v03 revision removed. A key_image without the standing fold cannot pin s14b's change (「折れた縁が立ち、表紙が浮いたまま」); the reuse is unsupported and the design's rationale misdescribes the asset.
findings.fix: Bake a new s14b key (half-closed ledger, folded edge standing), or keep the reuse but declare it an accepted gap and stop claiming the board already shows the standing fold.

findings.why: A hand/finger is part of a body. L52's arithmetic (one body has two hands) reads population 0 as headcount 0, which cannot hold hand 1; the emitted sentences would be「no one in the frame」+「1 hand in the frame」— contradictory, and inconsistent with m02a–m04b declaring the same body (フミ) as population 1. This is not acknowledged anywhere as a residual.
findings.fix: Set s03 population to 1 (+ hand 1), or record population 0 as a deliberate flash-image convention and note that L51/L52 will fire; resolve before stage ②.

findings.where: episodes/ep03.md:143 (踏切.base/.geography = 画像なし。意図だけ) / PLAN.md 0-j
findings.what: The crossing has no location reference image; appearance rides on prose across 26 new bakes.
findings.why: No pinning location image means the three fix-points (砂利と土 / 白黒の帯の腕木 / 灯なし) must be restated in every key_image prompt — the「写しは黙ってずれる」risk the PLAN itself names. Declared and deliberate, but a pilot-wide consistency risk.
findings.fix: Accepted as deliberate (corrected board is post-pilot); ensure the three fix-points are written verbatim into each key_image prompt, not summarized.

note: Arithmetic checks out: 28 shots = 28 attachments = 27 distinct images = 26 new bakes (24 + 2 fold) + 1 reuse (s14b), and durations sum to 420s (7:00) matching the four-act split. The dedicated s09 white-page key does solve the pen-tip-mark problem; Fumi's 4-view sheet, the crossing base (intent-only), the 30s limit (M01 cut to 18+18), and the Motion-character remainder (L20, declared) are all handled. The two open defects are the unsupported s14b board reuse and the s03 population 0 + hand 1 tension; 26 new bakes is operationally feasible (the author already produced 31) but carries drift risk without a location base.
